verdict.rationale: Document AI is an API-driven service. Its OCR, annotation and QnA features are invoked through request parameters (table_format, include_blocks, document_annotation), with official Python and TypeScript SDKs and inputs passed as URL, Base64 or file upload, so it runs headlessly in automated pipelines by design. A community user confirms programmatic processing but hit a timeout on a 900-page document and had to chunk it. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation guidance, a CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), documented batch/async handling for large jobs.
